newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks surge to day high on US data.
newsitem.headline: French stocks surge to day high on US data.

text.p: French shares pushed sharply higher, boosted by statistics on U.S. labour costs, traders said. Durable goods orders also showed a decline of 0.3 percent.
The market had been on the look-out for signs of inflationary pressure.
The CAC index was up more than 50 points and over two percent before giving back some of the gains.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 44.40 points or 1.74 percent at 2,594.65 at 1242 GMT, while the CAC-40 futures contract was up 41 at 2,596 from Monday's close.
Volume was a thin 2.83 billion francs.
